speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung disease (distal colonic aganglionic megacolon) with associated enterocolitis. The upright X-ray showing dilated proximal bowel and an absent rectal gas pattern in an infant with failure to thrive and abdominal distension is highly characteristic of this condition.
